### Alarmed and Resolved at the Same Time
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-november-7-2019.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:3
Points:
- Facing an overwhelming enemy coalition, Jehoshaphat felt human alarm but chose supernatural resolve.
- His determination to seek God first was a habit cultivated through daily faithfulness over time.
- Fear is a natural emotional response to threats, but it does not have to dictate how believers live.
- Turning to God regularly in small struggles strengthens our spiritual reflex for sudden crises.
- Instead of driving us away from God, fear can serve as the catalyst to anchor our trust in Him.

### Against All Odds
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-mar-7-2008-11570120.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:3-4
Points:
- Jehoshaphat faced a united invading army that left Judah hopelessly outnumbered.
- Instead of relying on his own resources, he led the entire nation to seek God through prayer and fasting.
- The king openly confessed his helplessness and kept his eyes focused entirely on the Lord.
- God assured His people that the battle belonged to Him and called them to stand firm.
- When trapped in seemingly impossible circumstances, believers should call upon God and trust His deliverance.
